product.title: Private Photo Shoot in Venice with Gondola Ride

description.text: Make your romantic memories of the canal city last forever with a private gondola ride and photo shoot in Venice. Explore the romantic corners of Venice with a professional photographer at the ready, then enjoy a 30-minute gondola ride as part of the package. Stops include Piazza San Marco, Rialto. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Venice landmarks, piazzas, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Venice who want a guided city experience without coordinating vaporetto routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Piazza San Marco, Rialto that define this Venice sightseeing experience, with a guide handling vaporetto connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
